_comment: THE AGENT'S BRAIN. Decides WHAT to make, WHERE to post it, and WHEN. Edit from the dashboard or by hand. Ships PAUSED - set paused=false (or click Resume in the dashboard) when you're ready to go live.
niche: your topic here (e.g. self-healing, science facts, fitness motivation)

default.image_style: cinematic, warm, healing, soft light, aesthetically pleasing, polished, high detail
default.note: Appealing, confident female-led aesthetic that draws attention but stays platform-safe.

detect.self_healing_spiritual: calming, healing, warm light, serene, hopeful

google_trends.note: pulse check only (news/celebrity heavy - weak for faceless reels)

reddit.note: curiosity content + self-healing/spiritual/emotional niche that converts to faceless reels

search_terms: money habits that changed my life
youtube_trending.note: YouTube's classic /feed/trending page was discontinued by YouTube (confirmed 2026-09-02, redirects to home) - this now searches yt-dlp against topic-relevant terms spanning ALL our categories (facts/tech, business/finance, fitness, self-healing), not just one niche, so results stay trendy AND on-brand instead of generic pop-culture trending.

topics: add your own topic ideas here
manual_list.note: Your hand-picked topics. Ranked above scraped sources.

trendpulse.note: Real-time trending FROM Mastodon and Bluesky - platforms we already post to, so this is on-brand signal not generic noise. Via the trend-pulse library (MIT, github.com/claude-world/trend-pulse), found + verified working 2026-09-02. Its own reddit source hits the same 403 block ours does, so left out here - google_trends already covered by our own source above.

tiktok.note: Manual only - API needs audit approval.

rules._privacy_note: Uploads start PRIVATE so a bug can never publish garbage. Set connections.json youtube.privacy='public' once you trust it.
rules._blocked_note: Titles/descriptions containing these phrases are RECOMMENDED-FLAG / policy-sensitive. The agent strips them before posting so nothing gets flagged.

learning._note: A topic scoring 1.5x the average is a WINNER and gets more like it. Below 0.5x is a LOSER and gets avoided.

schedule_steady.note: YouTube Short #1 of the week - 06:00 Tuesday, auto-made + auto-posted. (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
YouTube Short #2 of the week - 06:00 Friday, auto-made + auto-posted. (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
Monday image post - light content, no YouTube upload (quota-safe). (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
Wednesday text post - light content, no YouTube upload (quota-safe). (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
Thursday image post - light content, no YouTube upload (quota-safe). (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
Saturday text post - light content, no YouTube upload (quota-safe). (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)
Sunday image post - light content, no YouTube upload (quota-safe). (steady-state schedule, active once 50+ posts made)

dynamic_fillers._note: Real day-to-day randomization: different COUNT (5-8) and TIMES each day. At most 1 of them lands in the 8-11am low-traffic window.

dynamic_videos._note: No more fixed 8am slot - random 1-2 videos/day between noon and 9pm, when people are actually online.

dynamic_tiktok._note: TikTok's OWN track, separate from the shared YouTube video schedule above - always exactly 3/day, all between 12pm-5pm, hard-restricted to TikTok only (never also posts to YouTube/Telegram/etc).
